# Pandamonium v1.0.42

MCP tool results retain complete executable schemas and whole data records when passed back to the model. This backend repair prevents large tool references from losing their actual input fields during conversation continuation.

## MAD-842 — Integrations: make MAD MCP Portal tools native and unify connection identity

### Problem

Large MCP reference responses were cut after 8,000 pretty-printed characters, removing required query and collection arguments even though the audit retained them. Context trimming could also cut JSON inside a record. Numeric token budgets were incorrectly classified as credentials, and duplicate JSON text could retain a credential masked in structured content.

### Implementation

The shared formatter uses compact JSON, retains complete executable schemas, and bounds data by removing whole suffix records with explicit omission metadata. Original cursors and retained record IDs/citations stay intact. Context trimming preserves atomic JSON or reports that the complete result/schema could not fit. Structured and JSON text responses share this path; duplicate text is removed after secret redaction. Known nonnegative integer token-budget fields no longer trigger the credential gate; actual credentials remain protected.

### Product value and UI visibility

Agents receive the input definitions needed to call tools and the complete records needed to cite retrieved evidence. Invalid read arguments still receive one correction round, while terminal failures stop visibly. This changes backend model context and approval classification, with no new UI controls or provider-specific integration.

### Verification

Deterministic tests exercise real MCP parsing, execution, redaction, formatting, message assembly and context trimming through the agent loop. They verify a complete large schema, precise missing-query feedback, one corrected read, and returned record/citation data. Additional regressions cover bounded pages, empty search, minimum budgets, mounted-capability notices and secret protection. Full required CI and signed artifact checks gate publication.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

No dependency, database, authentication configuration or service routing changes. Existing context ceilings remain active: an oversized schema is explicitly omitted rather than partially supplied, and omitted data requires rereading a smaller page before advancing its original cursor. The host does not infer task success from plausible prose. This release is source-level repair; MAD-842 remains open pending configured Jarvis targeted/browse reads with verified citations and Discord acceptance. Installation remains operator-owned.
